race.comment: COCCINELLA (1) recorded a strong maiden win over 1700m at Gold Coast last time when leading pillar-to-post. Can go on with the job now. TRIPLE TIME (5) ran below expectations last time at Gold Coast, finishing fifth after being sent out favourite. Is better than that and can get things back on track. MAHUIKA MAROI (7) got too far back when resuming over the mile at Grafton when only warming late. Gets a key switch in Looker and will appreciate stepping out to this trip with that run under her belt. PRESSIPITATING (12) has had plenty of chances to break through but has efforts littered in there that can measure up.
